title: Oct 19: every merge is live
dek: A slide audit of what reached pointcast.xyz on October 19, 2026, what did not, and eight rules for the next publish.
author: cc
source: PointCast publish audit, October 19, 2026, about 8:20 PM PT. main 7efd2faa (merge of #1446). Deploy run 39340471436 succeeded at 4:15 PM PT. Slide deck prepared for Michael Hoydich to review. Prose is the audit summary, not Mike's voice.
body:
On October 19, 2026, every pull request that merged to main was live on pointcast.xyz. The deploy for main 7efd2faa, the merge of #1446, succeeded at 4:15 PM Pacific. That run is 39340471436. Deploy runs marked cancelled were newer pushes taking the lock. Nothing that merged is waiting on a deploy.

Checked about 8:20 PM Pacific the same evening. The check was HTTP 200, and the page title matched.

Live that day: Bot money lab and block 0710 (#1431), at /b/0710, /bot-money, and /internship-lab/. Enjoy. Money and block 0711 (#1436 and #1439), at /b/0711 and /nouns-money/enjoy. Nouns After Hours (#1437). Sunset Downs (#1438). Bloom Ledger as block 0714 (#1435), merged at 3:18 PM PT. The Almanac (#1424). The Hundred and its guest studios (#1441 and #1444). TAKES (#1446). The October 18 batch, pull requests #1415 through #1430, including /b/0709 and Staycamp at /b/0707. The Nouns Money page and the 2027 PNG zip from #1416, 12.2 MB, at /downloads/nouns-money-2027-png-000-024.zip.

Did not land. #1432 wanted block 0710 after main had already given 0710 to bot money. Bloom Ledger shipped as 0714 through #1435. #1433, the South Bay comic Signal Over the South Bay, wanted 0711 after main had already given 0711 to Enjoy. Money. #1440 is a draft that renumbers that comic to 0712, 0713, and 0715. #1445, Almanac Security Edition, and #1442 were pushed to branches whose pull requests had already merged, so those commits never reached main. Drafts #1434, #1447, and #1448 are still drafts. #1443 is open, not a draft, and it did not merge. An October 6 devnet post lived on pointcast-devnet-1, which was reset on October 8. It is not on pointcast-devnet-2, so it cannot be verified there.

Five causes. Block numbers collided. Branches were reused after their pull request merged. On October 18, CI failed because a script was missing, an asset was missing, or a test glob matched zero tests. Later reruns passed and those pull requests merged. A note still said Bloom Ledger was not published after /b/0714 was live. GROK_INBOX_TOKEN is unset, so an inbox answer cannot be written through the answer route.

Eight rules. Claim the block number on current main before merging, and fail CI on a duplicate /b/NNNN. Merged is not live: wait for the deploy of that exact commit, then check the status and the title. Fail CI on a missing script or asset, or on a test glob that matches zero tests. Never push to a branch whose pull request has merged. Close a replaced pull request with a link, and clear drafts older than about 14 days. Rebase and re-run checks before a batch of merges. For every publish, record the PR, the merge commit, the deploy run, the live URL, and the time you checked. Publish only through a branch, a pull request, and main, and check a devnet transaction right away.

This block is 0723. On main 06824a48 the blocks 0714 through 0719, 0721, and 0722 are taken. 0722 shipped in #1470 as “Be a witness from your browser, or claim a channel.” 0716 shipped as PointCast Guides in #1458. 0712 and 0713 are claimed by open pull requests. 0720 is claimed by open pull requests #1459 and #1461. 0723 is the next number that is free on that main and not already a block file in an open pull request, drafts included.

The slides are at /publishing/2026-10-19/. This deck counts as live only after its pull request merges and the deploy for that commit returns the page with a matching title.
